## LiquidityParameters.maxWithdrawalUtilization property

> Warning: This API is now obsolete.
>
> Per-market source ceilings will be removed in the next major. Use `defaultMaxWithdrawalUtilization` to configure one ceiling for every source. The Morpho API's `targetWithdrawUtilization` is no longer consulted.
>

If provided, defines the maximum utilization allowed to reach for each market, defaulting to `defaultMaxWithdrawalUtilization`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
maxWithdrawalUtilization?: Record<MarketId, bigint>;
```
